WP358 parent wire-fixture provenance
====================================

Named parent SHA
----------------
145b5ab2fde9bbee0620a0c1217ab8cdf55c44a7

Capture source
--------------
test/fixtures/wp358/capture_parent_rpc.cpp
SHA-256: 7B53B71282236DC03D93AA35ED5BEE00E86369D7148BF74BE2B992608D23593F

Procedure
---------
1. `git clone --shared . .wp358-parent-capture-tree`
2. Verify `git -C .wp358-parent-capture-tree rev-parse HEAD` equals the named
   parent SHA and `rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` is `false`.
3. Copy the capture source above into the shared clone and add only the
   one-shot `pelican_wp358_parent_capture` executable to the clone's
   `test/CMakeLists.txt`.
4. Configure with the WP358 feature flags (SPIR-V link, Studio, OpenXR, and
   standard render algorithms enabled). Existing locally populated sources at
   `C:/src/pelican2/build/_deps/*-src` were supplied through
   the matching `FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_*` variables; no dependency revision
   was changed.
5. Build `pelican_wp358_parent_capture` in Release and run:

       pelican_wp358_parent_capture.exe capture.clean-parent.ndjson

6. Verify the clone has no tracked diff under `src/core/userpublic` at capture
   time. The source registers seven behavior names whose combined response
   contains all 17 current schema types, feeds one newline-terminated
   `get_components` request to `RpcServer::run`, and writes `output.str()` in
   binary mode. Thus the fixture contains the JSON-RPC envelope and the
   response newline produced by `RpcServer::run`.

Parent defect and wire-only fixture seam
----------------------------------------
The named parent cannot register a typed behavior containing vec2, vec3, vec4,
or quat: `src/core/userpublic/details/schema/structfieldjson.hpp` lines
321/326/331 construct each scalar component with a braced JSON initializer,
which creates an array and is rejected as "must be a number" while computing
the registration fingerprint. The capture source leaves the parent tree
unchanged. It first registers four typed scalar placeholders, then replaces
only those four process-local `BehaviorRegistration` schema/canonicalizer
entries with Vec2/Vec3/Vec4/Quat wire fixtures. The registry lookup,
`EditorCommandService`, `get_components` handler, JSON-RPC envelope, and
`RpcServer::run` output path are all production parent code.
